title: Sierre-Zinal rules — rights and obligations of participants (art. 14–22)
claims: The rules state that there is no apparel requirement, that part of the course is above 2,000 m and that runners are advised to adapt their clothing to the conditions.
The rules note that Tourist runners may find a flashlight or headlamp useful because their race starts at night, and that the organiser does not provide a lamp deposit.
The rules prohibit poles on all courses and prohibit headphones.
The rules set minimum ages of 10 for the Tourist category and 18 for the Runner category, with no maximum age, and 10–17 for the junior race.
The rules publish absolute cut-off times: Chandolin 10:40:59 for Tourist and 14:10:59 for Runner, Tignousa 12:00:59 and 14:40:59, Hôtel Weisshorn 13:30:59 and 15:20:59, finish 17:30:59.
The rules list refreshment points at Beauregard km 4, Ponchette km 7.5, Chandolin km 12, Tignousa km 16, Hôtel Weisshorn km 20, Nava km 24 (water only) and Barneuza km 27.
The rules give Tourist starts between 04:45 and 06:15 and Runner starts at 10:30 for women and between 11:00 and 11:20 for the mixed field.
The rules allow runners to take shortcuts on the final descent between two points of the marked route.
